title: Watch Films in English in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin is one of Europe's best cities for films in their original language, with more than sixty cinemas showing English and other original versions.** The whole system just runs on a few German abbreviations, and once you can read them the city opens up.

**Learn four labels and you never buy the wrong ticket.** OV or OF is the original with no subtitles, OmU is original audio with German subtitles, OmeU is original audio with English subtitles, and DF or synchronisiert means dubbed into German.

**OmU is the trap.** For an English-language film it is fine, because you hear the English and can ignore the German subtitles. For a film in another language it means German subtitles only, so hold out for an OmeU screening.

**A short shortlist covers most nights.** Kino International on Karl-Marx-Allee, which reopened in early 2026 after a long restoration, Babylon Mitte, Hackesche Höfe Kino near where my tour ends, and the Delphi and Zoo Palast over in the west.

**Check ovkino.de or ov-berlin.de before you leave the hotel.** Both list only the original-version screenings across the city, filterable by cinema and language, so you do not cross town for a dubbed showing.
**A film is the perfect soft landing after a day on foot.** Do the sightseeing by day, then catch an OmeU screening in Mitte, a short walk from where my free walking tour ends.
